params.name: namesArray
params.description: Names of plug-ins, synchronized with numbersArray.

overloads.semanticRole: The PLUGIN LIST command fills in the numbersArray and namesArray arrays with the numbers and names of the plug-ins loaded and usable by the 4D application.

constraints: Values returned in numbersArray can be compared with the constants of the 'Is License Available' theme.
Includes all plug-ins usable by the application, both integrated ones (e.g. 4D Chart) and third-party plug-ins.
